parsed.rationale: All six members are empty type-alias-object declarations (fields_or_signature: []) that serve as SwiftUI @main entry-point aliases in their respective app or sample-app targets: WXUISampleApp, WallpaperSampleApp, PlayerHeaderViewApp, PlayerHeaderViewSampleApp, WatchXYC, and WXYCTVApp. Each alias is the top-level app struct for a distinct executable target across unrelated packages (WXUI, Wallpaper, PlayerHeaderView, app:WatchXYC, app:WXYC TV). The structural similarity is purely coincidental — every SwiftUI app must declare exactly one @main type, so the identical empty shape is an unavoidable platform convention, not a refactorable duplication. Consolidating these into a shared type would break each target's independent entry-point identity.
